name: PhilHealth
authority: Republic Act 11223 (Universal Health Care Act) s.10 with PhilHealth Circular 2019-0009 — 5% premium, floor PHP 10,000, ceiling PHP 100,000. NOT APPLIED: PhilHealth is a SINGLE 5% premium that is then split, not two independent 2.5% shares. The published split is premium = round(base * 5%, NEAREST_CENT); employee = floor(premium * 50) / 100; employer = premium - employee. The engine computes each share independently, which diverges by one cent at every half-cent premium (e.g. basic 11,653.50 -> premium 582.675). No token names that split. Report §4.5. Also NOT APPLIED: the base is the CONTRACTUAL basic salary, unprorated; the engine accumulates the measured BASIC_SALARY line, which is prorated for a partial month.

name: Pag-IBIG Fund (Home Development Mutual Fund)
authority: Republic Act 9679 s.7 with HDMF Circular 460 — 1%/2% employee, 2% employer, monthly compensation ceiling PHP 10,000. NOT APPLIED: the base is the CONTRACTUAL basic salary, unprorated; the engine accumulates the measured BASIC_SALARY line, which is prorated for a partial month.
